caption: The drawing depicts a single, full-length, off-the-shoulder dress set against a plain, light beige background. The dress is pale cream or ivory in color, featuring a fitted bodice with a slightly gathered waist, and a wide, voluminous skirt that reaches the floor. The neckline is decorated with small green leaves and yellowish flowers along the edge, and the waist is accentuated by a similar floral motif on one side. The short sleeves are decorated with two horizontal bands of blue or gray lace and have lace trim at the edge. Horizontal pleats run around the lower part of the skirt, accompanied by two bands of blue or gray lace, matching the sleeve trim. The overall composition centers the dress in the image, with no other objects or background elements present.
title: Wedding Dress
